messages:
nia_billing: Heads-up: this morning's usage reconcile shows ~64 customers billed at an experimental tier rate (exp_tier_B) instead of baseline tier. Estimated delta ~$9.1k. Looks tied to yesterday's pricing experiment rollout.

sam_pricing: I rolled out a tiered-pricing experiment for selective accounts (flag: pricing.exp_tier_b) to test elasticity. It should have been gated to 'beta' cohort only. Can you paste sample invoice ids?

nia_billing: Sample: inv_20241005_1045, inv_20241005_1062, inv_20241005_1101. net-sync-bot shows those posted to NetSuite as line_item code 'exp_tier_B'.

net-sync-bot: reconcile-20241005: found 64 invoices with line_item_code matching /exp_tier_B/. Imported to NS: 64 credit/debit lines.

eli_reconciler: Reconciler logic maps line_item_code->pricing_rule->unit_price. The experiment introduced a new code which our mapping table didn't include, so system defaulted to experimental price in Stripe export and posted that to NS. That explains the delta.

sam_pricing: Oops. The feature flag rollout mistakenly included 'beta' and 'auto-convert' cohorts. I only intended 'beta'. Will pause the rollout and patch the flag targeting.

frank_ops: Pausing rollout now. Also disabling automated export until we confirm mapping exists.

zoe_cs: Are any paying enterprise customers affected? We need to notify CS if invoices change.

nia_billing: Mostly SMB pilot accounts but 3 mid-market customers included (SumoTech, ClearGrid, BrightLane). I'll prepare a short customer notice template.

sam_pricing: Plan: 1) rollback experiment flag to beta-only (done) 2) backfill mappings: add exp_tier_B -> pricing_rule mapping to reconciler so previous invoices align to intended price or are flagged for manual review 3) run backfill to re-evaluate 64 invoices and emit adjustments if needed. ETA: patch in 2h.

eli_reconciler: For backfill I'll compare Stripe line_item.unit_amount + metadata.pricing_version against mapping. If mismatch, create adjustment draft and queue approval for billing. Will surface list in sheet: https://redwood.internal/sheets/finance/exp-tier-backfill-20241005

frank_ops: Export paused. I'll re-enable after backfill done and accounting sign-off. Adding alert: if any experiment introduces new line_item_code not in mapping, block export and page pricing on-call.

nia_billing: Thanks. Please also include a log entry for audit specifying rollout id and affected invoices. I'll coordinate customer comms if adjustments are posted. :thumbsup:
